entities.name: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network to initiate CS fallback or 1xCS fallback calls, respond to mobile terminated CS fallback requests, or request establishment of NAS signalling connection and bearers for packet services when additional information beyond SERVICE REQUEST is needed.

entities.name: Service type
entities.description: Indicates the type of service requested in the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: NAS key set identifier
entities.description: Identifies the NAS security key set used for the message.

entities.name: M-TMSI
entities.description: Mobile identity used to identify the UE in the network.

entities.name: CSFB response
entities.description: Conditional information element for CS fallback response.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status
entities.description: Optional information element indicating the status of EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Device properties
entities.description: Optional information element describing UE device properties.

entities.name: UE request type
entities.description: Optional information element indicating the type of UE request.

entities.name: Paging restriction
entities.description: Optional information element for paging restriction parameters.

entities.name: CS fallback or 1xCS fallback needed
entities.description: Condition where UE needs to initiate or respond to CS fallback calls.

entities.name: Additional information needed beyond SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Condition where UE requires establishment of NAS signalling connection and bearers for packet services with additional information.

relations.description: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message contains Service type IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message contains NAS key set identifier IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message contains M-TMSI IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message conditionally contains CSFB response IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message optionally contains EPS bearer context status IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message optionally contains Device properties IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message optionally contains UE request type IE.
EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message optionally contains Paging restriction IE.
Condition of CS fallback or 1xCS fallback needed triggers sending EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message.
Condition of additional information needed beyond SERVICE REQUEST triggers sending EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message.
